title: #021. Minimax Server Load Balancing
subtitle: Linearize a max-of-sums objective by introducing an epigraph peak variable.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { assignments, peakLoad }.
judge.m1: assignments must have {p0} rows (one per job).
judge.m3: Job {p0} cannot run on incompatible server {p1} (received {p2}).
judge.m4: Job {p0} assignment fractions must sum to 1 (received {p1}).
judge.m5: Reported peakLoad ({p0}) does not match maximum server load ({p1}).
judge.m6: Valid assignment, but peakLoad ({p0}) exceeds optimal ({p1}).
